mentions.name: Data-efficient transformer attention mechanism
mentions.description: This project is a transformer attention mechanism that appears more data-efficient than standard dot-product attention, with work underway on a performant backwards (gradient) kernel for it.
mentions.problem: Usual dot-product attention is less data-efficient.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a transformer attention mechanism which seems to be more data-efficient than the usual dot product, and I'm trying to write a performant backwards kernel for it.
